direct_gpt_code_findings.finding: appendReceipt does not call assertAppendOnly; accepted receipt downgrade protection exists only as a standalone helper and is not enforced on write.
readLedger parses state but does not verify receipt_sha256 or validate order_sha256 integrity.
evidence_paths is only checked as a string; existence, repository containment, file type and content hash are not verified.
acceptance_gate accepts any single node command without shell metacharacters; node -e is permitted, so an order can pass with a trivial process.exit(0) and can select arbitrary Node scripts.
No idempotency key or duplicate order/receipt guard exists.
The module is not connected to daily-external-hire.yml or scripts/run-daily-external-hire.mjs; it is currently a standalone self-test harness.
The sample accepted receipt used node -e process.exit(0); it proves command exit only, not that a hired AI delivered an artifact meeting task acceptance.

reviewer.reason: Insufficient evidence from named files; output generic and violates required review format.

ruling.decision: Do not connect current hire-phase1 v0 to automatic daily execution or any payment path until a safety patch is merged and tested.
required_patch: Use a named allowlist of acceptance gate IDs; never execute arbitrary node command or node -e from an order.
Verify evidence_paths are repository-contained regular files and bind their SHA-256 into the receipt.
Enforce assertAppendOnly inside appendReceipt; accepted is terminal and cannot be downgraded.
Add idempotency key bound to order_id + order_sha256 + state; duplicate invocation must not append a second receipt.
Validate receipt_sha256 and required money invariants on every readLedger line.
Bind actual provider/model/request_id/output hash/reviewer evidence from the executor; never accept seat self-attestation.
Only after these pass, integrate one zero-value Phase1 order into daily pipeline.
ruling.acceptance: Dedicated PR; Harness preflight on exact main; focused tests for allowlisted gates, path traversal, missing evidence, hash tampering, accepted-terminal, duplicate/idempotency, actual seat metadata, paid=false, amount_usd=0, financial_execution=false; required CI green; independent review PASS.
ruling.rollback: Revert the Phase1 safety patch; keep the daily pipeline disconnected and all payment switches disabled.

money.testnet: preparation only; one transaction max 0.05 test USDC on Base Sepolia after test-only controller/payee/purpose/budget and adapter are verified

next_step: Create a dedicated Phase1 safety PR; do not run the daily hire or any payment until its tests and independent review pass.
